_comment: Reference points drawn on the record chart. Not Lean-verified here; costs are translated into the contract's model (one hash unit per started 512-bit block, one-time part only).

points.label: leanVM XMSS
points.note: The one-time signature under leanVM's XMSS: 42 chains of 128 bits with 3-bit chunks (7 steps each) and target sum 195, so 42·7 − 195 = 99 chain steps to verify; the leaf hash of the 42 chain ends (5376 bits) costs 11 blocks; the message encoding 1. The Merkle path (32 more) belongs to the many-time layer and is not counted. Lower bound: none was known (0).

points.label: This paper
points.note: A Verification Lower Bound for Hash-Based One-Time Signatures: the forest scheme verifies every signature in 106 units (Lean proof pending), and the lower bound 25 is proved in Lean (the lower baseline of this site).
